settings.title: Sleep is hard
settings.body: I cannot settle, wake in the night, snore, or never feel refreshed.

settings.title: Focus is hard
settings.body: I have brain fog, cannot start, forget things, or keep losing attention.

settings.title: I have nothing left
settings.body: I cannot switch off, have no drive, or rest does not restore me.

settings.heading: What feels closest right now?
settings.body: Choose the nearest description. You do not need to know the diagnosis or the professional title before you begin, and you can change direction at any time.

settings.note: Mirellis provides orientation and navigation. It does not diagnose or replace medical care.
